Every clause of Proposition 8.3 is stated in the repository, for general sources, with the same mathematical content: the (8.13) identity and its mean form, flatness of the cutoff remainder at every order, P in S_alpha and p_m in M_alpha, shell and fibre support, and all of (8.14) including divergence freeness, the Y-average clause under the vanishing weighted moment, the pointwise Y-independent case, and the class statements. The differences are encoding: the proposition is never assembled as one theorem, the epsilon of Delta beta rides in the graph direction, and the (Z,T)-support clause appears as operator locality. Hence different_formulation and SINGLE_SOURCE_OK, with low-severity packaging findings.

findings.summary: No single declaration states Proposition 8.3. Every clause of (i) and (ii) is stated, each for a general source, but spread over PressureStream, VariableGaugeMean, MeanMomentBounds, GaugeAliasDecay and PhysicalMeanDomain.

The clause Delta beta in M_{alpha+1} was found only for the concrete epsilon-scaled instances (temporal update, rank update); the generic statement for an arbitrary desired axial increment was not found.

The epsilon in Delta beta = -epsilon d_Z Psi_* is not a prefactor in Lean: streamBeta carries no epsilon, and the factor sits in the graph direction (epsilon n . axial) used by the divergence and class theorems.

The clause that p_m and Psi retain the (Z,T)-support of the source is not stated as a support inclusion; it appears as fibre-locality of the operators, from which the support claim needs the extra step T(0)=0.
